messages:
elaine: Heads-up — hitting mypy/pyright errors with async streaming helpers. autogen models for chat deltas are typed as Any and users get attribute errors.
sam: Minimal repro? SDK 0.17.2?
elaine: Yep, wheel from this morning. Snippet:
from redwood import AsyncClient
from typing import AsyncIterator

client = AsyncClient(token="x")

async def fetch() -> None:
    async with client.chat.stream("gpt-x") as s:
        async for evt in s:  # mypy: evt: Any
            print(evt.text)  # mypy: "Any" has no attribute "text"

anita: We see the same. Codegen maps streaming delta fragments to Any — pydantic models are only for full responses.
jake: Workaround: cast at call site, but that forces users to assert types:
from typing import AsyncIterator, cast
s = cast(AsyncIterator[ChatDelta], client.chat.stream("gpt-x"))
Not great.
mike: Pyright is looser locally; mypy blocks. We should pick an explicit stub type: AsyncIterator[ChatDelta]. ChatDelta could be a TypedDict/Protocol to avoid heavy deps.
elaine: Two options: (1) extend OpenAPI->codegen to synthesize ChatDelta model for streams, or (2) expose a typed wrapper that yields assembled fragments.
anita: Option 1 preferred. Also keep backwards compat: emit ChatStreamDelta and add overloads so stream() returns Iterator[ChatStreamDelta] / AsyncIterator[ChatStreamDelta].
sam: That will change public typing surface. Are CI checks failing now?
ci-bot: CI: mypy check failed on pr/3421 — https://ci.redwood.dev/pr/3421
jake: WIP PR adds ChatDelta TypedDict and updates client/chat.pyi signatures: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/3421
mike: With that, mypy passes for the repro, but an internal sample-app that expects raw JSON broke. We can add overloads like stream(..., raw_json=True) -> AsyncIterator[dict].
elaine: Action items: (a) land typed delta model + overloads, (b) add mypy/pyright regression test for snippet above, (c) document workaround/migration notes and add example in examples/chat_streaming.py. Who will finish the PR?
anita: I will. Will update PR to add overloads and CI test, and ping eng-runtime if the delta shape needs alignment.
sam: Also consider adding a short example users can copy.
jake: Suggest prefer TypedDict for deltas to avoid Pydantic import cost in lightweight apps.
anita: Agreed. Will prototype TypedDict + optional runtime validators behind a flag.
elaine: Thanks — reassigning follow-ups to @anita. :thumbsup: If others hit this, paste a snippet here.
